topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by outlining its focus on the molecular and cellular mechanisms governing the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Principles of Innate Immune Recognition: PAMPs, DAMPs, and Non-Self Discrimination
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses microbial infection and tissue damage using conserved molecular signatures that distinguish self from non-self.

topics.label: Toll-Like Receptors: Localization, Function, and Signaling Cascades
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the genomic hardwiring, compartment-specific localization, and intracellular signaling pathways of Toll-like receptors.

topics.label: Cytosolic Pattern Recognition and the Inflammasome Pathway
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine intracellular sensing families and the assembly of multiprotein inflammasome complexes required for activating mature inflammatory cytokines.

topics.label: The Inflammatory Cascade: Sentinel Activation, Leukocyte Extravasation, and Systemic Effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics follow the progression of the inflammatory response from sentinel cell signaling and leukocyte recruitment to lymphatic drainage and systemic hyperinflammatory complications.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the passive and active mechanisms that extinguish inflammation, guide wound healing, and manage persistent pathogens through granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks and previews the upcoming lecture topic.
